target_selector.title: Target Selector
target_selector.tooltip.focus_selected: When enabled, a manually selected enemy is considered before normal target scoring.
target_selector.tooltip.draw_selected: Draws a circle around the currently selected target.
target_selector.tooltip.selected_color: Color used by the built-in selected-target circle.
target_selector.tooltip.force_selected: When enabled, the manually selected target may be returned even when it is outside the requested targeting range.
target_selector.tooltip.enable_force_key: Enables the temporary Only attack selected Key below.
target_selector.tooltip.reset_release: When enabled, a temporarily selected target is cleared shortly after the Only attack selected Key is released.
target_selector.tooltip.auto_priority: Resets enemy champion priority sliders to the built-in default values when enabled. Disable it to customize priorities manually.
target_selector.tooltip.target_mode: Controls how valid enemy champions are ranked after ignored-target, range, invulnerability and TargetFilter checks.
target_selector.tooltip.priorities: Priority ranges from 1 to 5. Higher values make a champion more strongly favored by target-selection modes that use champion priority. 5 is the highest priority and 1 is the lowest.
